title: Junior Data Engineer
description: Entry-level data engineering position focused on foundational SQL, Python script automation, data extraction, basic Airflow DAGs, dbt models, and automated data quality checks under guidance.

skills.rationale: Writing clean analytical SQL, joins, CTEs, and window functions is non-negotiable for daily data tasks.
Strong Python programming for data extraction, manipulation, and pipeline scripting.
Building dbt models, implementing tests, and documenting schemas is a core daily activity.
Creating and scheduling basic Airflow DAGs with TaskFlow API.
Understanding dimensional modeling, star schemas, and fact/dimension concepts.
Working with S3/GCS object storage, Parquet files, and Medallion architecture basics.
Writing data quality assertions with Great Expectations or Soda.
Dockerizing data jobs, writing unit tests with pytest, and using CI/CD.
Basic PySpark DataFrame operations and understanding distributed architecture.
Foundational understanding of Kafka topics and producer/consumer mechanics.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is the sum of weighted scores divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.description: Insufficient foundational knowledge in SQL and Python data manipulation.

partially_ready.description: Meets basic scripting needs but lacks production orchestration and data modeling depth.

ready.description: Solid junior engineer capable of writing ELT pipelines and maintaining dbt/Airflow workflows under guidance.

exceeds.description: Exceeds junior requirements with strong grasp of distributed engines and data warehouse performance.
